notes.title: Holiday Update
notes.content:
After our studio have celebrated Hanukkah, we have started the process of developing the New Year's Update. And now the Standing Man has received:

[list]
[*]Improved optimization (it is possible to use the slider to adjust the number of messages on the map);
[*]Additional achievement "Overmind".
[/list]

Enjoy folks!

AG
